title: How YouTube Works And How To Grow
script:
YouTube is the world's largest video platform, with over two billion people watching every month. [Visual: cityclip.mp4]
The secret to growth is a strong hook in the first five seconds that stops the scroll. [Visual: techclip.mp4]
Consistency matters more than perfection. Upload on a regular schedule your audience can rely on. [Visual: brand_cover.jpg]
Great thumbnails and titles decide whether people click. Make them clear, bold, and curious. [Visual: github-profile.png]
Watch time and audience retention are what the algorithm rewards most. Keep viewers hooked. [Visual: logo-automation.png]
Engage with your community, reply to comments, and build real connection. Start today and keep improving. [Visual: greenscreen_pure.mp4]
